name: auth.token.verify
description: Verifies an externally created JWT token from the required [token] child node, against one or more trusted [issuer]/[issuers] supplied by the caller

issuer.description: Trusted issuer the token's issuer must equal; meta data is never fetched from issuers not supplied by the caller

issuers.description: Trusted issuers, the token's issuer must equal one of them; meta data is never fetched from issuers not supplied by the caller

audience.description: Audience the token must have been issued to, typically the OAuth client ID; not validated unless [audience] or [audiences] is supplied

audiences.description: Audiences the token must have been issued to, it must match one of them; not validated unless [audience] or [audiences] is supplied

output.description: Returns token claims as child nodes such as [issuer], [email], and optional [name] and [nonce]
